items.title: Brown's Hotel, Mayfair
items.description: Main decorating contractor at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, a Rocco Forte hotel, from 2022 to 2024. Wallcoverings, fine painting and French polishing.
items.summary: Full decorating package, including premium wallcoverings, fine painting and French polishing.
paragraphs: Brown's Hotel is a Rocco Forte hotel on Albemarle Street, Mayfair. From 2022 to 2024 Mr Wallcover was the main decorating contractor.
The package was a full decorating brief: fine painting, premium wallcoverings, French polishing and other specialist finishes.
The photographs and the three short films were taken on site. They are our own record of the rooms.
items.caption: Photographed on site by Mr Wallcover.

items.title: The OWO, Whitehall
items.description: Vescom wallcoverings to walls and joinery at The OWO, Raffles London at the Old War Office, Whitehall, 2020 to 2023.
items.client: The OWO, Raffles London at the Old War Office
items.summary: Vescom wallcoverings to walls and to parts of the joinery.
paragraphs: The OWO, Raffles London at the Old War Office, stands on Whitehall. It looks over the Royal Horse Guards and sits a short walk from Downing Street, Buckingham Palace and St James's Park.
Between 2020 and 2023 the team installed Vescom wallcoverings to walls and to parts of the joinery, in the bedrooms and in several other areas, as part of the refurbishment.
The photograph is of the building from Whitehall. It is not a photograph of a finished room.
items.caption: The Old War Office, Whitehall. A photograph of the building.
